mapper.sql: ID, BUDGET_APPROVAL_ID AS PROJECT_CODE, PROCUREMENT_NAME AS PROJECT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NAME, AMOUNT AS BUDGET_AMOUNT, SUPPLIER_NAME, STATUS, CREATED_TIME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, PROCUREMENT_TYPE, PROCUREMENT_METHOD, REQUIREMENT_DESCRIPTION, APPLICANT_NAME, ATTACHMENT_NAME, COALESCE((SELECT L.MATERIAL_ID FROM PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_MATERIAL L WHERE L.DEMAND_ID = PROCUREMENT_DEMAND.ID AND L.IS_PRIMARY = 1), (SELECT L.MATERIAL_ID FROM PROCUREMENT_MATERIAL_LINK L WHERE L.DEMAND_ID = PROCUREMENT_DEMAND.ID), SOURCE_PROJECT_ID) AS SOURCE_PROJECT_ID, (SELECT LISTAGG(L.MATERIAL_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY L.MATERIAL_ORDER) FROM PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_MATERIAL L WHERE L.DEMAND_ID = PROCUREMENT_DEMAND.ID) AS SOURCE_MATERIAL_IDS

DELETED = 0

SELECT FROM PROCUREMENT_DEMAND WHERE ID = #{id} AND DELETED = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_DEMAND ( ID, BUDGET_APPROVAL_ID, PROCUREMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, PROCUREMENT_TYPE, AMOUNT, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NAME, PROCUREMENT_METHOD, REQUIREMENT_DESCRIPTION, APPLICANT_NAME, ATTACHMENT_NAME, STATUS, SUPPLIER_NAME, DELETED, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{departmentName}, #{procurementType}, #{budgetAmount}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{procurementMethod}, #{requirementDescription}, #{applicantName}, #{attachmentName}, 'DRAFT', NULL, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_MATERIAL_LINK (DEMAND_ID, MATERIAL_ID, CREATED_AT) SELECT D.ID, M.ID, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PROCUREMENT_DEMAND D, BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE M WHERE D.ID = #{id} AND D.DELETED = 0 AND M.ID = #{materialId} AND M.STATUS = 'PARSED'

INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_DEMAND_MATERIAL (DEMAND_ID, MATERIAL_ID, MATERIAL_ORDER, IS_PRIMARY, CREATED_AT) SELECT D.ID, M.ID, #{materialOrder}, #{primary}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PROCUREMENT_DEMAND D, BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE M WHERE D.ID = #{id} AND D.DELETED = 0 AND M.ID = #{materialId} AND M.STATUS = 'PARSED'
mapper.update: UPDATE PROCUREMENT_DEMAND SET PROCUREMENT_NAME = #{projectName}, DEPARTMENT_NAME = #{departmentName}, PROCUREMENT_TYPE = #{procurementType}, AMOUNT = #{budgetAmount}, SUBJECT_CODE = #{subjectCode}, SUBJECT_NAME = #{subjectName}, PROCUREMENT_METHOD = #{procurementMethod}, REQUIREMENT_DESCRIPTION = #{requirementDescription}, APPLICANT_NAME = #{applicantName}, ATTACHMENT_NAME = COALESCE(#{attachmentName}, ATTACHMENT_NAME) WHERE ID = #{id} AND DELETED = 0 AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE PROCUREMENT_DEMAND SET DELETED = 1, UPDATED_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND DELETED = 0
